summary: Ran the impeccable skill's context loader on the AgentSettings target and read the routing and polish references, then began inspecting the running Settings UI in the browser (Agent, Skills, Extensions tabs) while reading the supporting source files (SettingsScreen.svelte nav groups, SettingsNav.svelte, WorkspaceConfigurePanel InstructionsEditor usage, settings/layout.css, and the files that use the segmented control) to understand the incumbent visual truth before editing.
decisions: Treated the request as a `polish` command based on the routing reference: the project has PRODUCT.md and an existing Settings surface, so work proceeds against the incumbent implementation rather than init/new-work.
Selected AgentSettings.svelte as the target surface for the initial context load via `context.mjs --target apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/AgentSettings.svelte`.

Identified the settings sidebar nav structure from SettingsScreen.svelte: groups for 'This device' (Appearance, Chat, Context, Connection, Agent, Skills with skillCount badge, Extensions) and 'Gizmo' (About).
